# `team.repo.add`

Grant a repository to a team

Session-only, organization owners. Rejected for all-scope teams and cross-org repositories.

- Method and path: `POST /{org}/-/teams/{team}/repos`
- Scope: `repo:write`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie team repo add`
- MCP: `team_repo_add`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$schema` | body | no | `string` |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |
| `org` | path | yes | `string` |
| `repo` | body | yes | `string` |
| `team` | path | yes | `string` |
